context: Asuka advises Sakura on pacing study.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: study advice; adverbs (せっかく/だいたい/しばしば/一気に/楽しむ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 一気に勉強すると、疲れちゃうんです。
lines.en: Studying all at once tires me out.
lines.style: troubled adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 一気にやらず、少しずつ進めましょう。
lines.en: Rather than all at once, advance bit by bit.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: だいたい、何時間が良いですか?
lines.en: Roughly how many hours are good?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: だいたい一時間ごとに、休みましょう。
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: しばしば集中が、切れるんです。
lines.style: honest adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: せっかくの時間を、楽しんで学びましょう。
lines.en: Enjoy and learn in your precious time.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured encouraging clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 楽しむと、続けられそうです。
lines.en: If I enjoy it, I think I can keep going.
lines.style: motivated adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: しばしば振り返れば、力になりますよ。
lines.en: Reviewing often will build your strength.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
